lakefarm_farmer.text: Come in, mind the dog. The dog minds nobody. The kettle is on. It is always on, it is practically the law.
Beatrix Potter bred Herdwicks right here in the Lakes. When she died in 1943 she left about fourteen farms to the National Trust.

then.text: That flask is spoken for, love. Come back when you've climbed something.

else.text: Herdwick wool is rough as a doormat, so it goes in carpets, not jumpers. Here, take a flask. You look like you have been up Helvellyn.
